usage_contract.authoritative_title_rule: Use canonical_title and role dates in experience[].roles. Do not substitute title aliases unless explicitly generating a historical resume reproduction.
usage_contract.current_source_rule: src_apm_general wins when job titles, current role ordering, or current-facing education conflict with older files.
usage_contract.achievement_rule: Achievements supported only by supplemental sources are retained but marked website_default=false when they are too detailed, stale, or unnecessary for a minimal portfolio.
usage_contract.conflict_rule: Do not silently resolve unresolved conflicts. Use conflicts[] and data_quality_notes[] to decide whether to omit a disputed fact from public copy.
usage_contract.privacy_rule: Do not expose phone numbers or private/internal employer material. This dataset intentionally excludes the phone number present in source resumes.
usage_contract.rendering_rule: Website components should read from this dataset (or a typed derivative of it) instead of hard-coding job titles, dates, or metrics.
